audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted its own explanations on five of seven rows: win[0] said 'Skill' while whys[0] says level 1 is yours; win[1]/win[2] said 'Vladimir' while both whys call those levels even; win[3]/win[4] said 'Skill' while the whys give both to you.
audit.why: The packet chart is Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir, Vladimir, Vladimir, which fits 52.71% over 1440 games and matches the prose. The mirror audit on gangplank__vladimir already set both layers to the packet chart, so this side must agree.
audit.corrected: Five rows flipped to the packet chart, each proposed as a matched win[N] + phases[N].side pair in one atomic group.

audit.why: Your Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1 down to 16s, Tides of Blood 13s to 5s, Hemoplague a flat 120s. Gangplank's Parrrley is a flat 4.5s and Remove Scurvy 22s down to 14s — his real lane spike is items and crit, not a level. Spike text already frames level 6 as a roam tool, which is right.
audit.corrected: Named Remove Scurvy's 22s rank-1 cooldown in spikes[0] so the trade window is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Powder Keg was labelled '(W/E)' in spikes[0] and '(W)' in wants.you[1]. Powder Keg is E; W is Remove Scurvy. Two decisive interactions were also absent: Remove Scurvy heals and cleanses crowd control, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage.
audit.why: Riot's kit text: W 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health'; E 'uncovers a powder keg at target location'; R carries the trueDamage flag. Mislabelling the slot makes the tracking advice unusable, and MR is the wrong answer to his ult.
audit.corrected: Slot fixed in both places; Remove Scurvy's heal/cleanse written into spikes[0] and the anti-heal buy into itemization; Cannon Barrage's true damage written into spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing despite Remove Scurvy being the ability that decides extended trades.
audit.why: Listed in _missing for this matchup; W heals on a 22/20/18/16/14 cooldown, so anti-heal changes every attrition trade.
